kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
عممت (form I)
# عَمَمْتُ (ʕamamtu) /ʕa.mam.tu/: first-person singular past active of عَمَّ (ʕamma)
# عَمَمْتَ (ʕamamta) /ʕa.mam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of عَمَّ (ʕamma)
# عَمَمْتِ (ʕamamti) /ʕa.mam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of عَمَّ (ʕamma)
# عُمِمْتُ (ʕumimtu) /ʕu.mim.tu/: first-person singular past passive of عَمَّ (ʕamma)
# عُمِمْتَ (ʕumimta) /ʕu
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
